title: Log answer
description: The answer of the command log, on standard output: the console text of the machine in the request's id. JSON escaping can make the answer larger than the text: a line feed is written as 2 bytes. So the adapter keeps the last part of the text such that the text is at most 768 KiB as UTF-8 and the answer, as written, is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. A writer marks a member that the provisioner must read, such as /log, by listing its pointer in must_understand. The provisioner refuses an answer that lists a pointer it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.

log.description: The machine's console text, at most 768 KiB as UTF-8: the last part of the text when the whole text is larger. The text contains no U+0000. This schema checks the bound in characters, at most 786432.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /log. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.
